prompt-caching-a-correction-0.note: so, i see this, but what does it mean?  should we be caching it all?
prompt-caching-a-correction-0.reply: Less than the email implies, and I had it wrong when I first raised it. I said 22 of 23 call sites send a system prompt and only 2 cache it. Wrong: callClaude wraps every system prompt in cache_control and 17 of 41 call sites go through it. The 7 uncached are short strings under the 1,024-token minimum, so they cannot be cached at all. The 52% is a generic estimate from your account's overall hit rate, not a measurement of OMI. So no, do not cache everything. I shipped per-feature measurement (cacheReport) instead: quiet, uncached, wasting, working. Check it in a week. Only 'wasting' is worth acting on, because that is paying the 25% write premium with no reads earning it back.
